headline: This removes retired profile-image links and safely keeps the replacement image field in use.
what_changed: Old profile-image web links will be removed from the customer database when the change is published.
Customer profile images will continue using the newer stored image reference.
If this database change is undone later, the retired links will return as empty values.
good_news: The change is small and limited to retired profile-image data.
The change includes an undo path for the database structure.
